messages:
alex: Pinging sec — need temporary console elevation to run a quick telemetry scan for suspected leaked tokens in prod-cluster-a. ~30m. Tools: KMS unwrap + logs:read. JIRA INF-4823

maya: Can you list exact log groups + confirm no DB queries or exports?

alex: targets: prod-cluster-a telemetry logs + auth-service logs (last 24h). No DB access. Plan: ```kubectl --namespace=infra logs -l app=auth --since=24h | grep -i token | ./bin/scrub-logs --mask``` ; save masked snippets only.

sec-bot: Automated policy check: user alex has no active breakglass. To request, run `/request-elev INF-4823 duration=40m scopes=kms:unwrap,logs:read` — https://redwood.internal/tools/breakglass

sarah: Policy reminder — need ticket justification + data retention plan. Prefer ephemeral role <= 60m. No PII exported. See https://redwood.internal/policy/access#temp-elev :lock:

maya: I can +1 after james approves. tagging @james

james: OK to approve 40m one-off. Grant BG-175801. Conditions: must run scrub-logs binary, run from bastion, no external uploads, ping ops at start/end. Applying role now. :thumbsup:

david: I'm on-watch to review outputs and confirm masking before anything is archived.

alex: Starting run now from bastion-3 (BG-175801 active). Will paste a sanitized snippet + audit link when done.

alex: Finished — ran ~12m. Sample:
```
[sanitized] auth-service | 2025-05-12T14:03:22Z | user_id=***MASKED*** | event=token_rotate | note=masked
```
Found 2 token-like strings masked. No DB queries performed. Audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/BG-175801

james: Verified audit and usage. Revoking BG-175801 now.

sarah: Thanks. Attach the INF-4823 update with scrub steps, retention decision (90 days), and links. :white_check_mark:

luke-oncall: I'll keep infra alerts on for 24h and report anomalies.

alex: Filed update on INF-4823. No anomalies so far. Thanks all.
